segments.en: Hello everyone, welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: Katarina- And my name is Katarina.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜——我的名字是卡塔琳娜。

segments.en: So today we've got a great upper intermediate level lesson for our learners and we're talking about what?
segments.zh: 所以今天我们为各位学习者准备了一节很棒的中高级课程，我们要聊的是什么呢？

segments.en: Marco- Healthcare.
segments.zh: 马可——医疗保健。

segments.en: Katarina- Okay, this is a very important topic because it's been in the news recently, especially in the context of American politics.
segments.zh: Katarina- 好吧，这是一个非常重要的话题，因为它最近出现在新闻中，尤其是在美国政治的背景下。

segments.en: And so I don't know if you've heard things about this listeners, but the healthcare is a very hot topic.
segments.zh: 所以，听众朋友们，我不知道你们有没有听说过相关的事，但医疗保健是一个非常热门的话题。

segments.en: Marco- Exactly.
segments.zh: 马可——没错。

segments.en: So basically what we're talking about is health insurance, whether it's private health insurance or you know, like a standard national insurance program.
segments.zh: 所以基本上我们所说的是健康保险，无论是私人健康保险还是你知道的，就像一个标准的国家保险计划。

segments.en: Katarina- Exactly.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜——确切地说。

segments.en: And so your country might have a private option where you can pay a private company for insurance or public option like England or Australia, where your country will actually provide healthcare for you at no extra cost.
segments.zh: 因此，您的国家可能有一个私人选择，您可以向私人公司支付保险或公共选择，如英格兰或澳大利亚，您的国家实际上将为您提供免费的医疗保健服务。

segments.en: Marco- Very good.
segments.zh: 马可-非常好。

segments.en: So it's an interesting topic.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个有趣的话题。

segments.en: Why don't we jump directly into the dialogue and we'll be back to explain a couple of things.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不直接跳入对话，我们会回来解释一些事情。

segments.en: Katarina- Hey, honey, how was your day?
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：亲爱的，今天过得怎么样？

segments.en: Marco- It was all right.
segments.zh: 马可：还可以。

segments.en: I ran into Bill and we got to talking for a while.
segments.zh: 我遇到了比尔，我们聊了一会儿。

segments.en: He's in a bit of a jam.
segments.zh: 他遇上点麻烦了。

segments.en: Katarina- Why?
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：怎么了？

segments.en: What happened?
segments.zh: 发生什么事了？

segments.en: Marco- Well, his son had an accident.
segments.zh: 马可：他儿子出了意外。

segments.en: Bill doesn't have health insurance.
segments.zh: 比尔没有健康保险。

segments.en: This really got me thinking and I wondered if we shouldn't look into a couple of different HMOs.
segments.zh: 这让我认真想了想，咱们是不是也该了解一下几家不同的健康维护组织提供的医保计划。

segments.en: Katarina- Yeah, you're right.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：对，你说得没错。

segments.en: We aren't getting any younger and our kids are getting older.
segments.zh: 我们年纪越来越大，孩子们也在长大。

segments.en: Marco- Exactly.
segments.zh: 马可：没错。

segments.en: I searched on the web and found a couple of HMOs with low copays and good coverage.
segments.zh: 我在网上找到了几家健康维护组织的医保计划，个人定额自付费用低，保障范围也不错。

segments.en: The deductibles are low too.
segments.zh: 免赔额也很低。

segments.en: Katarina- Sounds good.
segments.zh: 卡特琳娜：听起来不错。

segments.en: Although, do you think we can qualify for insurance?
segments.zh: 不过，您认为我们有资格获得保险吗？

segments.en: Those insurance companies are real pirates when it comes to money.
segments.zh: 这些保险公司在收钱这件事上简直就是强盗。

segments.en: Marco- Well, we don't have any pre-existing illnesses or conditions, so we should be fine.
segments.zh: 马可：我们没有既往疾病或病症，应该没问题。

segments.en: Katarina- I wish our company or country provided us with healthcare.
segments.zh: Katarina-我希望我们的公司或国家为我们提供医疗保健。

segments.en: Marco- Not in a million years.
segments.zh: 马可：想都别想。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So a lot of interesting vocab here.
segments.zh: 所以这里有很多有趣的词汇。

segments.en: Why don't we take a look at it real fast in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不在语言要点中快速了解一下。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Katarina- Okay, Marco, this first phrase or acronym actually is three words that go together, HMO, and they're very, very common when you're talking about healthcare.
segments.zh: Katarina- 好吧，Marco，第一个短语或首字母缩略词实际上是三个在一起的词，HMO，当你谈论医疗保健时，它们非常非常常见。

segments.en: Marco- Right.
segments.zh: 马可：对。

segments.en: So an HMO means health maintenance organization.
segments.zh: 因此，HMO 意味着健康维护组织。

segments.en: Katarina- Okay, and so this is a part of the health insurance topic where we're talking about a company that will provide health insurance.
segments.zh: Katarina- 好的，所以这是健康保险主题的一部分，我们正在谈论一家将提供健康保险的公司。

segments.en: Marco- Right, so it's a company that provides health insurance, basically.
segments.zh: 马可：对，所以它基本上就是一家提供健康保险的公司。

segments.en: And if you go up to an HMO, some of the information that you'll receive is, for example, what your co-pay will be.
segments.zh: 例如，如果您使用 HMO，您将收到的一些信息就是您的共付额。

segments.en: Katarina- Okay, so sometimes with a private option, when you pay a company to give you health insurance, you can get a lower rate if you help pay for some of your care.
segments.zh: Katarina- 好吧，有时有私人选择，当您向公司支付健康保险时，如果您帮助支付一些护理费用，您可以获得较低的费率。

segments.en: So for example, a co-pay on a broken arm might be $20, but you pay $20, that's your co-pay, and your health insurance company pays the rest.
segments.zh: 因此，比如说手臂骨折的共付额可能是 20 美元，你付这 20 美元，这就是你的共付额，剩下的由你的医疗保险公司支付。

segments.en: And so sometimes co-pays are really high, they're really big, and that's kind of a bad deal because if you hurt yourself, you don't want to pay a lot.
segments.zh: 所以有时共付额真的很高、数额很大，这可不太划算，因为你要是受了伤，肯定不想花太多钱。

segments.en: But sometimes there's no co-pay, in which case your company will pay for all of the coverage.
segments.zh: 但有时没有共同支付，在这种情况下，您的公司将支付所有保险费用。

segments.en: Marco- All right, so another very similar word is a deductible.
segments.zh: Marco- 好吧，所以另一个非常相似的词是免赔额。

segments.en: Katarina- Okay, so a deductible is something that is fixed and it's in your insurance policy.
segments.zh: Katarina- 好吧，免赔额是固定的，它在您的保险单中。

segments.en: That means in the contract that you make with the insurance company, the deductible will be stated.
segments.zh: 这意味着在您与保险公司签订的合同中，将说明免赔额。

segments.en: So for example, my insurance plan, I have maybe a $500 deductible.
segments.zh: 例如，我的保险计划，我可能有 500 美元的免赔额。

segments.en: That means that in any situation, I get hurt or I get sick, I pay for the first $500 of care and then my insurance company pays for the rest.
segments.zh: 这意味着在任何情况下，我都会受伤或生病，我支付前 500 美元的护理费用，然后我的保险公司支付其余的费用。

segments.en: So if I have to have a $1,000 surgery, I pay $500 and then my insurance company pays the other $500.
segments.zh: 因此，如果我必须进行 1,000 美元的手术，我会支付 500 美元，然后我的保险公司支付其他 500 美元。

segments.en: Marco- Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 马可-好的，非常好。

segments.en: And well, you have these deductibles and everything and that depends on your coverage, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，你有这些免赔额和一切，这取决于你的覆盖范围，对吧？

segments.en: So coverage, how much the HMO covers you.
segments.zh: 所以覆盖范围，HMO 覆盖了多少。

segments.en: Katarina- That's right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：没错。

segments.en: And so you can find this also in your contract with your insurance company and coverage will include or not include something.
segments.zh: 因此，您也可以在与您的保险公司的合同中找到这一点，承保范围将包括或不包括某些内容。

segments.en: So coverage, for example, in a healthcare plan does not usually include your teeth.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，在医疗保健计划中的覆盖范围通常不包括您的牙齿。

segments.en: That's a separate kind of insurance.
segments.zh: 这是一种单独的保险。

segments.en: But a coverage can include emergency evacuation from a situation or ambulances, for example.
segments.zh: 但保险可以包括例如紧急撤离情况或救护车。

segments.en: And so coverage is what is included in your insurance plan.
segments.zh: 因此，保险范围是您的保险计划中包含的内容。

segments.en: Marco- Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 马可-好的，非常好。

segments.en: And our last word for today is to qualify for.
segments.zh: 我们今天最后一个词是 to qualify for。

segments.en: Katarina- All right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：好。

segments.en: So you might have heard this phrase before in the context of sports or academics.
segments.zh: 所以你可能以前在体育或学术的背景下听说过这句话。

segments.en: So he qualified for a scholarship or she qualified for the varsity volleyball team.
segments.zh: 所以他有资格获得奖学金，或者她有资格参加大学排球队。

segments.en: But in this case, to qualify for is to be able to use.
segments.zh: 但在这里，to qualify for 就是“有资格（享受）”的意思。

segments.en: Marco- To be eligible for.
segments.zh: Marco- 有资格获得。

segments.en: Katarina- To be eligible for.
segments.zh: Katarina- 有资格获得。

segments.en: Marco- So sometimes HMOs like in, for example, the United States will not accept a person who has maybe some health problems already because that would be too much of a risk, right?
segments.zh: 马可——所以有时像在美国这样的 HMO 不会接受一个可能已经有一些健康问题的人，因为这太危险了，对吧？

segments.en: For the company.
segments.zh: 对公司来说。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Katarina- That's right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：没错。

segments.en: Or you could qualify for a reduced rate because you have a very good health history.
segments.zh: 或者您可能有资格获得降低费率，因为您有很好的健康史。

segments.en: Marco- Okay.
segments.zh: Marco：好的。

segments.en: So this is very interesting.
segments.zh: 所以这很有趣。

segments.en: And we have a couple of other phrases that are very related to this language.
segments.zh: 我们还有一些与这种语言非常相关的短语。

segments.en: So why don't we move on now to Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不现在继续使用流利表达。

segments.en: Katarina- Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: Katarina- 流利表达。

segments.en: Marco- All right.
segments.zh: 马可- 好吧。

segments.en: So in Fluency Builder today, let's take a look at our first phrase.
segments.zh: 所以在今天的流利表达中，让我们来看看我们的第一个短语。

segments.en: We got to talking for a while.
segments.zh: 我们聊了一会儿。

segments.en: Katarina- Okay.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜-好的。

segments.en: We could say, for example, we started talking or we were talking for a while.
segments.zh: 例如，我们可以说，我们开始交谈或聊了一会儿。

segments.en: But this is a very spoken language kind of phrase where we'd say, we got to talking.
segments.zh: 但这是一种非常口语化的说法，我们会说 we got to talking。

segments.en: Marco- Right.
segments.zh: 马可：对。

segments.en: So it's not really grammatically correct because you would say we started talking.
segments.zh: 所以它在语法上其实不太正确，因为通常会说 we started talking。

segments.en: But sometimes people say we got to talking.
segments.zh: 但有时人们会说 we got to talking。

segments.en: So we got into a conversation, right?
segments.zh: 于是我们进入了对话，对吧？

segments.en: Katarina- That's right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：没错。

segments.en: And usually it's about something.
segments.zh: 通常它是关于某事的。

segments.en: So we could say, yeah, we got to talking about how we both went to the same high school.
segments.zh: 所以我们可以说，对，我们聊到了我俩都上过同一所高中。

segments.en: Or we got to talking about this movie that we both saw.
segments.zh: 或者我们开始谈论我们都看过的这部电影。

segments.en: Marco- Okay.
segments.zh: Marco：好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And well, they got to talking for a while and apparently his friend was in a bit of a jam.
segments.zh: 好吧，他们聊了一会儿，显然他的朋友有点堵了。

segments.en: Katarina- Okay.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜-好的。

segments.en: Jam is a food.
segments.zh: 果酱是一种食物。

segments.en: You can eat it.
segments.zh: 你可以吃它。

segments.en: You put it on bread.
segments.zh: 你把它放在面包上。

segments.en: Marco- Like marmalade, right?
segments.zh: 马可——像果酱，对吧？

segments.en: Katarina- Exactly.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜——确切地说。

segments.en: And to be in a jam is a fix or a difficult situation.
segments.zh: to be in a jam 指的是困境，或者棘手的情况。

segments.en: So it has a very different meaning and I want to warn you about that first.
segments.zh: 所以它有一个非常不同的含义，我想先警告你。

segments.en: But to be in a jam or to be in a bit of a jam is to be stuck.
segments.zh: 但 to be in a jam 或 to be in a bit of a jam 就是陷入困境、脱不开身。

segments.en: Marco- Okay.
segments.zh: Marco：好的。

segments.en: So you're in a difficult situation.
segments.zh: 所以你处境艰难。

segments.en: You have some problem.
segments.zh: 你有一些问题。

segments.en: Katarina- Yeah.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜-是的。

segments.en: So, Marco, I'm in a bit of a jam here.
segments.zh: 所以，Marco，我现在遇到点麻烦。

segments.en: Can I get your help with something?
segments.zh: 你能帮我个忙吗？

segments.en: Marco- All right.
segments.zh: 马可- 好吧。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And then the guy was talking about insurance and he said, this really got me thinking.
segments.zh: 然后那家伙在谈论保险，他说，这真的让我思考。

segments.en: So we got the verb got again there.
segments.zh: 所以这里我们又看到了动词 got。

segments.en: Katarina- All right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：好。

segments.en: So got me thinking.
segments.zh: 所以让我思考。

segments.en: That means I started thinking about something.
segments.zh: 这意味着我开始思考一些事情。

segments.en: So when we were talking about jam a minute ago, it got me thinking about how much I love breakfast.
segments.zh: 所以当我们一分钟前谈论果酱时，它让我想到我有多喜欢早餐。

segments.en: Marco- Very good.
segments.zh: 马可-非常好。

segments.en: So you would use it in that way, right?
segments.zh: 所以你会以这种方式使用它，对吧？

segments.en: Katarina- Like it reminded me.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜——就像它提醒了我。

segments.en: Marco- It reminded me or I started to really think about something.
segments.zh: 马可——它提醒了我，或者我开始真正思考一些事情。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And our last phrase is a pre-existing illness.
segments.zh: 我们最后一个短语是 a pre-existing illness（既往疾病）。

segments.en: Katarina- All right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜：好。

segments.en: So to exist is to be, to be around, pre-existing means existing before something else.
segments.zh: to exist 就是存在、存在于此，而 pre-existing 指的是在某事物之前就已经存在。

segments.en: And so you often hear this in terms of insurance when someone asks you about your pre-existing condition.
segments.zh: 因此，当有人问您您先前存在的状况时，您经常会在保险方面听到这一点。

segments.en: So that means if I'm signing up for an insurance plan, health insurance plan, and I have an interview with you, Marco, and you ask me this question.
segments.zh: 所以这意味着如果我要报名参加保险计划、健康保险计划，并且我接受了你的采访，Marco，你问我这个问题。

segments.en: Marco- What is your pre-existing condition?
segments.zh: 马可——你预先存在的状况是什么？

segments.en: Katarina- That means what diseases or health problems do I have right now?
segments.zh: Katarina-这意味着我现在有什么疾病或健康问题？

segments.en: Prior to signing up for this insurance.
segments.zh: 在注册此保险之前。

segments.en: And I say, Oh, I don't have any.
segments.zh: 我说，哦，我没有。

segments.en: And you're very happy because that means I'll be cheap.
segments.zh: 你会很高兴，因为这意味着我的保费会很便宜。

segments.en: But if I say, Oh, I have diabetes, then that is something that the insurance companies don't like because it's expensive.
segments.zh: 但如果我说，哦，我有糖尿病，那是保险公司不喜欢的，因为它很贵。

segments.en: Marco- Right.
segments.zh: 马可：对。

segments.en: Because you're more probable of getting sick or something like that.
segments.zh: 因为你更有可能生病或类似的东西。

segments.en: Katarina- Right.
segments.zh: 卡塔琳娜-对。

segments.en: So diabetes or cancer or Lyme disease, these are all pre-existing conditions.
segments.zh: 所以糖尿病或癌症或莱姆病，这些都是预先存在的疾病。

segments.en: And usually pre-existing conditions are diseases or health problems that you have that won't go away.
segments.zh: 通常预先存在的疾病是您遇到的疾病或健康问题，这些问题不会消失。

segments.en: Marco- Okay.
segments.zh: Marco：好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So we have a lot of words, a lot of phrases here.
segments.zh: 所以我们这里有很多单词，很多短语。

segments.en: Let's listen to the dialogue one last time and we'll be back.
segments.zh: 让我们最后一次听对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: Hey, honey, how was your day?
segments.zh: 嘿，亲爱的，你今天过得怎么样？

segments.en: It was all right.
segments.zh: 没关系。

segments.en: I ran into Bill and we got to talking for a while.
segments.zh: 我遇到了比尔，我们聊了一会儿。

segments.en: He's in a bit of a jam.
segments.zh: 他遇上点麻烦了。

segments.en: Why?
segments.zh: 为什么？

segments.en: What happened?
segments.zh: 发生什么事了？

segments.en: Well, his son had an accident.
segments.zh: 好吧，他的儿子出了事故。

segments.en: Bill doesn't have health insurance.
segments.zh: 比尔没有健康保险。

segments.en: This really got me thinking.
segments.zh: 这真的让我思考。

segments.en: And I wondered if we shouldn't look into a couple of different HMOs.
segments.zh: 我在想，咱们是不是也该了解一下几家不同的 HMO。

segments.en: Yeah, you're right.
segments.zh: 对，你说得对。

segments.en: We aren't getting any younger and our kids are getting older.
segments.zh: 我们年纪越来越大，孩子们也在长大。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: I searched on the web and found a couple of HMOs with low copays and good coverage.
segments.zh: 我在网上找到了几家健康维护组织的医保计划，个人定额自付费用低，保障范围也不错。

segments.en: The deductibles are low too.
segments.zh: 免赔额也很低。

segments.en: Sounds good.
segments.zh: 听起来不错。

segments.en: Although, do you think we can qualify for insurance?
segments.zh: 不过，您认为我们有资格获得保险吗？

segments.en: Those insurance companies are real pirates when it comes to money.
segments.zh: 这些保险公司在收钱这件事上简直就是强盗。

segments.en: Well, we don't have any pre-existing illnesses or conditions, so we should be fine.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们没有任何既往疾病或病史，所以应该没问题。

segments.en: I wish our company or country provided us with health care.
segments.zh: 我希望我们的公司或国家为我们提供医疗保健。

segments.en: Not in a million years.
segments.zh: 想都别想。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So the health care issue is pretty heated debate now in the United States because many people don't have health care and it's not very accessible, right?
segments.zh: 所以现在美国的医疗保健问题争论得非常激烈，因为许多人没有医保，而且它不太容易获得，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's a huge debate because it's very, very divided by party lines.
segments.zh: 这是一场巨大的争论，因为它非常非常按党派立场分裂。

segments.en: We say there's the Republicans on the right and there's the Democrats on the left and the Democrats want a public health care option.
segments.zh: 我们说右边有共和党人，左边有民主党人，民主党人想要公共医疗保健选择。

segments.en: They want health care to be available for everyone for free.
segments.zh: 他们希望免费为每个人提供医疗保健。

segments.en: And many of them do.
segments.zh: 他们中很多人确实这么想。

segments.en: And a lot of Republicans say, no, it should be private because if it's private, there's competition and that means there's better health care.
segments.zh: 许多共和党人说，不，它应该是私人的，因为如果它是私人的，就会存在竞争，这意味着有更好的医疗保健。

segments.en: And so there's a really big debate and people are getting very angry about it.
segments.zh: 所以有一场非常大的辩论，人们对此非常生气。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And I think it's something that's very interesting and most importantly, seeing the difference of health care systems around the world, right?
segments.zh: 我认为这是非常有趣的事情，最重要的是，看到世界各地医疗保健系统的差异，对吧？

segments.en: So for example, our listeners, they are from everywhere in the world.
segments.zh: 例如，我们的听众，他们来自世界各地。

segments.en: So we would like to know what the health care system is like there.
segments.zh: 所以我们想知道那里的医疗保健系统是什么样的。

segments.en: Do you have free universal health care in your country or do you also have to pay for private companies or private health insurance?
segments.zh: 您是否在您的国家/地区有免费的全民医疗保健服务，或者您还必须支付私人公司或私人健康保险的费用？

segments.en: And if you have one or the other system, do you think it's a good thing?
segments.zh: 如果你用的是其中一种制度，你觉得这是好事吗？

segments.en: Do you think it's a bad thing?
segments.zh: 你认为这是一件坏事吗？

segments.en: What do you think needs some work?
segments.zh: 你觉得哪些地方还需要改进？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: I definitely agree with universal health care.
segments.zh: 我绝对同意全民医疗保健。

segments.en: I think it's a relief because it's like one thing less to worry about.
segments.zh: 我认为这是一种解脱，因为它就像一件事不用担心。

segments.en: I can't imagine like, you know, if I don't have health care right now and I'm not covered by a private company and something happens to me tomorrow, then you know, what's going to happen?
segments.zh: 我无法想象，你知道，如果我现在没有医疗保健，而且我没有被私人公司覆盖，明天发生在我身上，那么你知道，会发生什么？

segments.en: And I think it's a basic human right personally.
segments.zh: 我个人认为这是一项基本的人权。

segments.en: So I think it's in the best interests of a country to invest in it because it means that their people are more productive and happier.
segments.zh: 所以我认为投资它符合一个国家的最大利益，因为这意味着他们的人民更有生产力和更快乐。

segments.en: And healthier.
segments.zh: 而且更健康。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So that's all the time we have for today.
segments.zh: 好了，今天的节目就到这里。

segments.en: Be sure to come to EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 一定要来englishpod.com。

segments.en: Leave your questions and comments and we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 留下您的问题和意见，我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Bye everyone.
segments.zh: 大家再见。

segments.en: Take care.
segments.zh: 保重。
